widgetTool.name: acn-amount-input
widgetTool.description: Emit a numeric amount entry widget with optional preset buttons for transfers or payments. Before calling this tool, ask for the amount in words that match what it is for (send, borrow, deposit, pay): 'How much would you like to borrow?' for a loan, 'How much would you like to send?' only for a payment.

name.description: Required. Always output the exact string: 'acn-amount-input'
